suiteName: TraceShield AI 2.0 Functional Validation & Security Test Harness

tests.name: Clean technical evidence
tests.expected: ALLOW, 0 findings, sanitization: null, release: ALLOWED, copy: ENABLED
tests.actual: ALLOW, 0 findings, sanitization: null, release: ALLOWED, copy: ENABLED
tests.details: Evaluates benign code with zero sensitive patterns through pre-filter to fast allow release.

tests.name: Credential targeting Public AI
tests.expected: Decision: SANITIZE, Sensitive finding: SECRET, Sanitization: executed, Verification: PASS, Release: ALLOWED
tests.actual: Decision: SANITIZE, Findings: 1, Sanitized: true, VerifPassed: true, Release: ALLOWED, HardRule: Hard Rule 3: Credential targeting Public AI Tool (Mandatory Sanitize)
tests.details: Findings: SECRET present (true). Sanitization executed (true). Verification passed (true). Hard rule returned: Hard Rule 3: Credential targeting Public AI Tool (Mandatory Sanitize). Final Decision: SANITIZE, Release: ALLOWED.

tests.name: Critical credential targeting Public GitHub
tests.expected: Decision: BLOCK, Verification: PASS, Release: BLOCKED, Copy: DISABLED
tests.actual: Decision: BLOCK, Verification: PASS, Release: BLOCKED, Copy: DISABLED
tests.details: Demonstrates key security invariant: Verification PASS does NOT allow release when risk decision is BLOCK.

tests.name: Internal destination context
tests.expected: Destination multiplier 0.6x, Score ~68.4, Decision: SANITIZE, Release: ALLOWED
tests.actual: Multiplier: 0.6x, Score: 68.4, Decision: SANITIZE, Release: ALLOWED
tests.details: Proves destination exposure multiplier modulates the risk score and enables sanitized release for internal targets.

tests.name: Local IDE destination awareness
tests.expected: Destination multiplier 0.2x, Score ~22.8, Decision: ALLOW, Release: ALLOWED
tests.actual: Multiplier: 0.2x, Score: 22.8, Decision: ALLOW, Release: ALLOWED
tests.details: Validates destination awareness: exact same sensitive token produces ALLOW when targeting local development tool.

tests.name: Governance policy variation
tests.expected: Scores vary by policy: CyberLab (0.8x) < CloudOps (1.2x) < OpenSource (1.5x)
tests.actual: CyberLab: 45.6 (REVIEW) | CloudOps: 68.4 (SANITIZE) | OpenSource: 85.5 (BLOCK)
tests.details: Proves policy profile modifier directly modulates the composite risk calculation without changing content.

tests.name: Verification failure and release hold
tests.expected: Verification: FAILED, Residual detected: YES, Raw token bleed: YES, Failure reason populated
tests.actual: Passed: false, NoSecrets: false, NoBleed: false, Reason: "Residual secrets detected: AWS_ACCESS_KEY [REDACTED_RESIDUAL_SECRET] | Pre-sanitization raw token bleed detected"
tests.details: Tests closed-loop quarantine: verifier independently catches residual credentials and raw token bleed.

tests.name: Data contract separation (Transient raw_value isolation)
tests.expected: raw_value strictly excluded from findings_metadata, telemetry, and safe_mappings
tests.actual: Raw in metadata: false, Raw in telemetry: false, Raw in safe_mappings: false
tests.details: Asserts that Layer B (SensitiveMatch.raw_value) is transient in-memory only and never serialized to Layer A public interfaces.

tests.name: FindingMetadata structure and safety
tests.expected: Structural metadata present, zero sensitive string leak in serialized metadata
tests.actual: Structural fields: OK, Leaks secret: false
tests.details: Verifies FindingMetadata can be safely logged, audited, or displayed without secret disclosure.

tests.name: Multi-category entity replacement
tests.expected: IP, Host, Email, and Credential replaced with typed replacement tokens
tests.actual: IP: true, Host: true, Email: true, Secret: true
tests.details: Verifies sanitizer correctly applies distinct categories of replacement tokens across diverse sensitive entities.

tests.name: Relational mapping consistency for repeated entities
tests.expected: Repeated entity (10.20.14.5) consistently receives [INTERNAL_IP_1] in both positions
tests.actual: IP_1 count: 2, IP_2 count: 1, Relational map: OK
tests.details: Ensures relational correlation is maintained for debugging without leaking real IPs.

tests.name: Surrounding text preservation (Zero offset corruption)
tests.expected: Exact preservation of surrounding prefixes, separators, and suffixes
tests.actual: Prefix: true, Middle: true, Suffix: true
tests.details: Right-to-left surgical splice guarantees downstream replacement does not displace preceding text offsets.

tests.name: Independent rescan catches residual secrets
tests.expected: passed: false, no_residual_secrets: false
tests.actual: passed: false, no_residual_secrets: false
tests.details: Closed-loop verifier treats sanitizer output as untrusted and rescans with detector registry.

tests.name: Pre-sanitization raw token bleed detection
tests.expected: passed: false, no_raw_tokens_bleed: false, leak_detected: true
tests.actual: passed: false, no_raw_tokens_bleed: false, leak_detected: true
tests.details: Cross-checks every key from original token map against final text to guarantee zero bleed.

tests.name: Residual high Shannon entropy anomaly check
tests.expected: passed: false, no_entropy_anomalies: false
tests.actual: passed: false, no_entropy_anomalies: false, violations: 1
tests.details: Flags statistical entropy anomalies >= 4.8 Shannon score on unredacted strings >= 24 chars.

tests.name: Release Gate: Non-BLOCK + Verification PASS -> RELEASE ALLOWED
tests.expected: release_status: ALLOWED, verified_safe_text: populated
tests.actual: release_status: ALLOWED, verified_safe_text: YES
tests.details: When risk decision is non-BLOCK and verification passes, content is released.

tests.name: Release Gate: BLOCK + Verification PASS -> RELEASE BLOCKED
tests.expected: release_status: BLOCKED, verified_safe_text: null (BLOCK overrides Verifier PASS)
tests.actual: status: BLOCK, verifPassed: true, release: BLOCKED, copy: DISABLED
tests.details: CRITICAL SECURITY INVARIANT: Verification PASS must NEVER override a policy BLOCK decision.

tests.name: Destination awareness 4-point matrix
tests.expected: LOCAL_IDE (0.2x) < INTERNAL_SYSTEM (0.6x) < PUBLIC_AI (1.2x) < PUBLIC_GITHUB (1.6x)
tests.actual: LOCAL_IDE: 0.2x (Score 22.8, ALLOW) | INTERNAL_SYSTEM: 0.6x (Score 68.4, SANITIZE) | PUBLIC_AI: 1.2x (Score 100, SANITIZE) | PUBLIC_GITHUB: 1.6x (Score 100, BLOCK)
tests.details: Demonstrates that destination exposure context reaches the risk engine and scales mathematical risk scores.

tests.name: DEMO-1: Production Server Log executes real pipeline
tests.expected: Status: BLOCK, Release: BLOCKED, Findings >= 3
tests.actual: Status: BLOCK, Release: BLOCKED, Findings: 7
tests.details: Multi-leak log executes real pipeline without hardcoded bypass.

tests.name: DEMO-2: Terminal Screenshot OCR stream executes real pipeline
tests.expected: Status: SANITIZE, Findings > 0, Release: ALLOWED (Hard Rule 3 Public AI)
tests.actual: Status: SANITIZE, Findings: 10, Release: ALLOWED
tests.details: OCR screenshot buffer processed through real detection and risk pipeline to mandatory sanitization.

tests.name: DEMO-3: Clean Benchmark Code fast-allow path
tests.expected: Status: ALLOW, Release: ALLOWED, Findings: 0
tests.actual: Status: ALLOW, Release: ALLOWED, Findings: 0
tests.details: Tests benign algorithmic code through early-exit fast allow path.

tests.name: DEMO-4: Verification Hold Injection evaluation
tests.expected: Decision reaches sanitization/verification, Verifier detects failure (passed=false), Release: VERIFICATION HOLD, Copy: DISABLED
tests.actual: RiskStatus: SANITIZE, VerifPassed: false, Release: VERIFICATION HOLD, Copy: DISABLED
tests.details: DEMO-4 executed through full pipeline: Decision=SANITIZE, Sanitization=true, Verifier executed=true, Verifier passed=false, Failure reason="Residual secrets detected: SYNTHETIC_DEMO_KEY [REDACTED_RESIDUAL_SECRET] | Pre-sanitization raw token bleed detected", Release=VERIFICATION HOLD

tests.name: Hard Rule 1: Private Key to External Destination
tests.expected: Hard Decision: BLOCK, Rule: "Hard Rule 1: Private Key targeting Public Destination (Mandatory Block)"
tests.actual: GitHub: BLOCK ("Hard Rule 1: Private Key targeting Public Destination (Mandatory Block)"), AI: BLOCK
tests.details: Tests deterministic hard invariant: Private keys to external endpoints always mandate BLOCK.

tests.name: Hard Rule 2: High-Severity Secret to Public GitHub
tests.expected: Hard Decision: SANITIZE, Rule: "Hard Rule 2: Critical Credential targeting Public GitHub..."
tests.actual: Decision: SANITIZE, Rule: "Hard Rule 2: Critical Credential targeting Public GitHub (Mandatory Sanitize/Block)"
tests.details: Validates Hard Rule 2 trigger on critical credentials targeting public repositories.

tests.name: Hard Rule 3: Credential targeting Public AI Tool
tests.expected: Hard Decision: SANITIZE, Rule: "Hard Rule 3: Credential targeting Public AI Tool (Mandatory Sanitize)"
tests.actual: Decision: SANITIZE, Rule: "Hard Rule 3: Credential targeting Public AI Tool (Mandatory Sanitize)"
tests.details: Validates Hard Rule 3 trigger requiring sanitization for external AI endpoints.

tests.name: Deterministic latency measurement integrity
tests.expected: Real latencies measured via performance.now() across all executed stages
tests.actual: Prefilter: 0.19ms, Sanitize: 0.1ms, Verify: 0.18ms, Total: 0.4ms
tests.details: Assures all telemetry latency values are directly measured and not hardcoded mock numbers.

tests.name: AI invocation truthfulness (Zero fabricated inference)
tests.expected: ai_invoked: false, ai_latency_ms: null, truthful reason string
tests.actual: ai_invoked: false, ai_latency_ms: null, reason: "Deterministic path — AI context not required."
tests.details: Ensures pipeline does not pretend local AI ran when no validated model is loaded.

tests.name: Runtime platform separation (Target vs Actual Host)
tests.expected: Target platform: Snapdragon X Series; Actual Host: Linux container (Other); QNN: UNAVAILABLE
tests.actual: Host OS: Linux, Platform: Other, Env: CONTAINER / NON-TARGET, QNN: UNAVAILABLE
tests.details: Validates that the host does not falsely claim Snapdragon NPU or QNN acceleration when executing on x86 container.

tests.name: Network measurement truthfulness
tests.expected: instrumented: true, requestCount: 0, bytesSent: 0
tests.actual: instrumented: true, requestCount: 0, bytesSent: 0
tests.details: Truthfully instruments local requests without claiming unverifiable system-wide network silence.

invariants.name: Deterministic detection remains active
invariants.rationale: Detection registry executes regular expressions and entropy calculations on all inputs before downstream decisions.

invariants.name: AI/context analysis cannot directly release sensitive content
invariants.rationale: AI context modifies finding severity modifiers only; final release is strictly mediated by the risk engine and independent verifier.

invariants.name: Sanitization does not automatically authorize release
invariants.rationale: Sanitized buffers must pass both independent verification and risk policy non-BLOCK checks before release.

invariants.name: Verification is independent of sanitization
invariants.rationale: verifySanitization runs as a decoupled pass rescanning output with fresh regex and token map bleed checks.

invariants.name: BLOCK remains release-blocking even when verification passes
invariants.rationale: Validated in TS-003 and TS-017: If decision is BLOCK, release_status is BLOCKED regardless of verifier output.

invariants.name: Verification failure blocks release
invariants.rationale: Validated in TS-007 and TS-014: Any failed verifier check halts release in VERIFICATION_HOLD.

invariants.name: Clipboard is never silently cleared or overwritten
invariants.rationale: Clipboard writeText is invoked solely upon explicit user button click in TransformationWorkspace and disabled when blocked.

invariants.name: Raw sensitive values are not persisted in telemetry
invariants.rationale: Validated in TS-008: raw_value is isolated to transient memory and stripped from findings_metadata and telemetry JSON.

invariants.name: Snapdragon/QNN claims require actual runtime validation
invariants.rationale: Validated in TS-028: The system reports QNN UNAVAILABLE on non-target platforms instead of spoofing acceleration.

invariants.name: Demo scenarios use the real pipeline
invariants.rationale: Validated in TS-019 through TS-022: All four demo scenarios run through runTraceShieldPipeline without bypass.
